name: Create Tables
query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS advisor (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS booking_slot (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    advisor_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES advisor(id),
    start_time TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    end_time TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    is_booked BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    UNIQUE(advisor_id, start_time, end_time)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS booking (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    slot_id INT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES booking_slot(id),
    advisor_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES advisor(id),
    customer_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    customer_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    graph_event_id VARCHAR(255),
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);
